title: Targeting NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway by Cryptotanshinone Prevents Preeclampsia-Like Symptoms: Involvement of Placental Angiogenesis and Oxidative Stress.
authors: Gao, Weina; Li, Pingping; Liu, Kexin; Zheng, Yanfang; Zhang, Xiaoli; Li, Xiufang
journal: FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究隐丹参酮通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路改善子痫前期症状，虽含分子对接但核心是疾病表型与氧化应激，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Preeclampsia (PE) is a pregnancy complication that requires urgent attention, with early recognition and timely management being crucial to ensure the safety of both mother and child. Cryptotanshinone (CTS), a fat-soluble diterpenoid quinone compound derived from Salvia miltiorrhiza Bunge, exhibits various pharmacological activities, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidative stress, and immunomodulatory effects. This study investigates the preventive role of CTS in PE. In this research, an in vivo rat model of PE was established through intraperitoneal injection of N(omega)-nitro-L-arginine methyl esters (L-NAME). CTS was administered at dosages of 30 and 60 mg/kg/day to evaluate its impact on symptoms resembling those of PE. The results indicated that CTS ameliorates the maternal and fetal outcomes associated with PE and mitigates placental injury. Treatment with CTS restored inflammatory markers as well as oxidative stress and vascular molecular indicators. Additionally, we developed an in vitro model induced by hypoxia/reoxygenation (H/R) in HTR-8/SVneo cells and treated the cells with 20 and 40 muM of CTS. Our findings demonstrated that CTS reduces H/R-induced damage in HTR-8/SVneo cells while alleviating oxidative stress and promoting angiogenesis in human umbilical vein endothelial cells. Mechanistically, we identified NF-kappaB as a target for CTS through network pharmacology analysis combined with molecular docking. Subsequent experiments confirmed that CTS mitigates trophoblast cell damage via inhibiting the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. In conclusion, our study reveals that CTS prevents the development of PE-like symptoms by reducing oxidative damage within trophoblastic cells and enhancing angiogenesis through inhibiting the NF-kappaB pathway. These findings provide a novel strategy for the treatment of PE.
abstract_zh: 子痫前期（PE）是一种需要紧急关注的妊娠并发症，早期识别和及时管理对于确保母婴安全至关重要。隐丹参酮（CTS）是从丹参（Salvia miltiorrhiza Bunge）中提取的一种脂溶性二萜醌类化合物，具有多种药理活性，包括抗炎、抗氧化应激和免疫调节作用。本研究探讨了CTS在PE中的预防作用。在本研究中，通过腹腔注射N(omega)-硝基-L-精氨酸甲酯（L-NAME）建立了大鼠PE体内模型。以30和60 mg/kg/天的剂量给予CTS，以评估其对PE样症状的影响。结果表明，CTS改善了与PE相关的母体和胎儿结局，并减轻了胎盘损伤。CTS治疗恢复了炎症标志物以及氧化应激和血管分子指标。此外，我们建立了由缺氧/复氧（H/R）诱导的HTR-8/SVneo细胞体外模型，并用20和40 μM的CTS处理细胞。我们的研究结果表明，CTS减少了H/R诱导的HTR-8/SVneo细胞损伤，同时减轻了氧化应激并促进了人脐静脉内皮细胞的血管生成。在机制上，我们通过网络药理学分析结合分子对接确定了NF-kappaB为CTS的靶点。后续实验证实，CTS通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路减轻了滋养层细胞损伤。总之，我们的研究揭示，CTS通过抑制NF-kappaB通路减少滋养层细胞内的氧化损伤并增强血管生成，从而预防PE样症状的发展。这些发现为PE的治疗提供了一种新策略。
